# CISO-in-a-Box

> A comprehensive guide to cybersecurity and risk management for organizations, aspiring CISOs, and security professionals.

Canonical site: https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site
Authoritative content repository: https://github.com/CroodSolutions/CISOinaBox
Source commit: 2882c6067c3aa748d66152fb90540d71d74349da

## Guide

- [Business Continuity Planning - BCP](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/business-continuity-planning---bcp.md): Planning to keep critical business services operating during disruptive events.
- [CISO Security Management Strategy Guide](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/ciso-security-management-strategy-guide.md): Operating the security function through roles, planning, governance, and execution.
- [Cyber Attacks and Defense: Threat Intelligence, Adversaries, and Collective Defense](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/cyber-attacks-and-defense-threat-intelligence-adversaries-and-collective-defense.md): Who attacks organizations, how they operate, and how defenders can respond.
- [Cyber Incident Response Strategy Guide for CISOs](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/cyber-incident-response-strategy-guide-for-cisos.md): How to prepare for, manage, and learn from cybersecurity incidents effectively.
- [Cyber Insurance](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/cyber-insurance.md): How cyber insurance works and how to evaluate coverage, readiness, and tradeoffs.
- [Cybersecurity and IT Career Pathways](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/cybersecurity-and-it-career-pathways.md): Career paths, skill development, and progression toward security leadership roles.
- [Cybersecurity Operations (SecOps) Program Maturity Guide](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/cybersecurity-operations-secops-program-maturity-guide.md): Monitoring, detection, triage, and operational practices for effective SecOps teams.
- [Disaster Recovery - DR](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/disaster-recovery---dr.md): Recovery strategies for restoring technology, data, and operations after major outages.
- [Frameworks and Standards](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/frameworks-and-standards.md): A practical guide to common security frameworks, standards, and control mappings.
- [Getting Started](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/getting-started.md): Practical first steps for improving security and building momentum.
- [Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Strategy Guide for Cybersecurity Programs](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/governance-risk-compliance-grc-strategy-guide-for-cybersecurity-programs.md): Core governance, risk, and compliance practices for building accountable programs.
- [Identity and Access Management (IAM) Overview](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/identity-and-access-management-iam-overview.md): Foundations of IAM, access control, lifecycle management, and privileged access.
- [Mapping Your Attack Surface](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/mapping-your-attack-surface.md): How to identify exposed systems, services, identities, and external dependencies.
- [Overview of CIS18 Critical Security Controls](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/overview-of-cis18-critical-security-controls.md): A structured walkthrough of CIS18 and the controls that reduce common risk.
- [Product and Software Security](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/product-and-software-security.md): How to evaluate, build, and secure software and technology products safely.
- [Resources](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/resources.md): Reference links, tools, templates, and supporting material across the guide.
- [Secure Business Process Optimization](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/secure-business-process-optimization.md): Ways to improve business processes without introducing avoidable security gaps.
- [Security Architecture and Engineering](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/security-architecture-and-engineering.md): Design principles and engineering patterns for resilient, defensible systems.
- [Security Awareness: Building a Human Firewall](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/security-awareness-building-a-human-firewall.md): How to build user awareness programs that reduce phishing, fraud, and human error.
- [Security Leadership Strategy Guide for CISOs](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/security-leadership-strategy-guide-for-cisos.md): Leadership approaches for setting direction, influencing stakeholders, and scaling impact.
- [Understanding Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) for CISOs](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/understanding-enterprise-risk-management-erm-for-cisos.md): How to translate cyber issues into business risk, impact, and decision-making.
- [Vulnerability Management and Risk](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/vulnerability-management-and-risk.md): Methods for identifying, prioritizing, and reducing vulnerability-driven risk.
- [Contributing](https://ciso-in-a-box.github.io/ciso-in-a-box-site/markdown/contributing.md): We welcome contributions from the community! This project thrives on collaborative efforts to improve and expand its content. Here's how you can contribute:
